name: Fun'ya no Yasuhide
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 22); Porter’s note gives the dates as: 9th century.

poems.title: The mountain wind in autumn time
poems.author: Fun'ya no Yasuhide
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 22
poems.text:
The mountain wind in autumn time
Is well called ‘hurricane’;
It hurries canes and twigs along,
And whirls them o’er the plain
To scatter them again.

poems.title: 22. 吹くからに 秋の草木の しをるれば (Fuku kara ni aki no kusaki no shioreba)
poems.author: Fun'ya no Yasuhide
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 古今集
poems.text:
吹くからに 秋の草木の しをるれば
むべ山風を あらしといふらむ
